parsed.why: Division is 'Most Protective': public-accommodation and hate-crime coverage, panic-defense repeal, open markers. But no enforcement data for visitors, and national passport, entry-screening and custody exposures persist unaltered.

Public accommodations covering hotels/transport retained by 67.8% ballot vote, hate-crime reporting unit, care shield, most-protective tier. Dead-letter sodomy statute tangential; national entry and document regime still applies.

Statewide birth-sex facilities statute reaching bathrooms, shelters, dorms and prisons plus religious-refusal service denial with immunity and no non-discrimination cover: a tier-1 universal exposure layered on the hostile national regime.

Adds prison care denial, surgical document route and zero gender-identity service protection to the national regime, but documents no facility ban or targeting of visitors, so sits near, slightly below, the parent.

Strong visitor-facing protections: public accommodations since 1993, hate-crime cover, care shield reaching travellers, open markers, conversion ban, most-protective tier. Dated birth-sex custody placement and national entry rules cap it below higher tiers.
